training: For evaluation year Y, both new arms share classifiers trained before Jan 1 of Y-2. Prediction windows must end by that boundary. Fixed 96 features and original model hyperparameters.
calibration: Two-year pool spans Y-2 and Y-1 with observation/prediction boundary purging and removal of training HARPs. One-year calibration is its subset with observation_start >= Jan 1 of Y-1.
evaluation: Use original annual evaluation rows, removing any HARP shared with new training or two-year calibration. All available arms use these same rows; report removals.
probability_policy: Refit sigmoid calibrators separately on each fixed window; same data fits probability mapping and selects threshold. Fixed 0.45 logistic/0.55 XGBoost mixture.
threshold_policy: Select at recall >=0.95 on each calibration window, freeze before evaluation; no evaluation retuning.
skips: Keep each arm independently available only with both training/calibration classes and nonempty evaluation. Original baseline available only when its frozen annual fold exists; never silently substitute. Zero-positive evaluation years retain FP metrics.
acceptance: No automatic promotion. Require higher precision with recall >=0.95, AP no lower, Brier/log loss no higher versus BOTH controls in every originally baseline-comparable positive year, with complete candidate coverage. Report unmatched years separately.
scope: Adaptive retrospective comparison; no duration grid, no split-date tuning. Paired same-year contrasts isolate window duration under shared shorter training; original baseline contrasts also change training history.
